title: Informal Economy Database

perception_sources.source: World Economic Forum Executive Opinion Surveys

source_page_claims.count_reconciliation: The source page claims 11 measures, while its category bullets enumerate two output-method series, four employment indicators and six perception-source indicators. These may not map one-to-one to workbook variables; reconcile the actual workbook variable inventory and paper appendix before claiming an exact count.

license_review.general_world_bank_terms_summary: World Bank Data Catalog datasets default to CC BY 4.0 unless specifically labelled otherwise; third-party datasets may have separate restrictions.

conflicting_or_ambiguous_evidence.interpretation_limit: This label appears in a reproducibility package that lists the Informal Economy Database as an included source. It is a warning to resolve the terms for the exact workbook; it does not by itself prove that the source-page workbook is prohibited or permitted for redistribution.

license_review.required_next_action: Resolve the exact workbook's governing dataset license and any third-party data restrictions in the dataset metadata or with World Bank Data before ingestion, bundling, public redistribution, or commercial use.

qualification_gates: confirm exact workbook edition and digest
capture workbook sheet and variable inventory without altering the original
reconcile measure count against the 2021 methodology paper and workbook variables
record definition, unit, denominator, geography, period, method, missingness and source for each variable
separate DGE and MIMIC estimates as alternative model-based measures; do not average or sum by default
separate model estimates from survey-derived employment and perception indicators
check country-year coverage and missingness before comparing economies
resolve source-specific terms and third-party restrictions before any data redistribution or commercial use
do not infer illegality or adjudicated illicit output from informality estimates
interpretation_ceiling: Historical cross-country context only after the workbook variables, methods, coverage and terms have been independently qualified; not a current-year estimate, not a complete global shadow-economy total, and not evidence of illegal activity.
